scope: Original Beta spawn caps, ancestry census and every-world-tick scheduling on the native insertion pipeline
subsequent_upstream_changes: Only 1.20.1 bridge tables and MiddleCompat changed through the final upstream revision; tested Beta paths are unchanged. The full final build covers the combined tree.

mocreatures.budget_control: Discard all entities counted by any Beta root once at world tick 200 in the disposable stage. No cap, weight, time or RNG retuning.

morecreeps.budget_control: Discard all entities counted by any Beta root once at world tick 200 in the disposable stage. No cap, weight, time or RNG retuning.

original_semantics.cadence: Each ordinary world tick for all configured groups, respecting native eligibility and enable flags.
original_semantics.census: All loaded entities, including persistent entities and corpses awaiting removal; original class/interface membership takes precedence over native host category.
original_semantics.player_footprint: Union of inclusive radius-eight chunk squares: 289 chunks for one nonspectator player.
original_semantics.threshold: loadedCount <= capacity * uniqueFootprintChunks / 256, using integer arithmetic.
original_semantics.gate_timing: Once before the whole group chunk loop; cluster overshoot is preserved. Recount before the next group.

integration.native_stage: ServerChunkCache native custom-spawner stage; exception-safe cycle scope.
integration.selection_hook: NeoForge PotentialSpawns event, scoped to original category and biome policy before weighted selection and native membership checks.
integration.duplicate_prevention: Owned entries are excluded from ordinary selection only in the configured category/biomes; Beta selection retains those original entry objects and weights.

portable_regressions: Default Beta capacities and live mapped writes
Footprint edges, negative coordinates, overlapping and duplicate players
Original ancestry precedence and independent multi-root membership
Weighted entry order, identity, group sizes and weights preserved
Unchanged list identity outside explicit scheduling scope
Category and biome ownership isolation for vanilla overrides
Overworld ownership excludes unrelated Nether biome
Removed policies block ordinary selection without entering Beta selection

generic_guards.broader: passed: 21 baseline mentions in 7 files; none added

build_fixture_policy: Private actual-mod tests remain opt-in. Long scheduler observation and its temporary control phases require explicit flags; normal builds do not launch Minecraft or require private jars.

spawn_fidelity: Native candidate geometry, group-size sampling and modern world-height sampling remain; the complete Beta candidate algorithm is not emulated.
Modern terrain fauna generation and native vanilla-animal lifetime differ from Beta; loaded fauna can still fill the correct class budget.
confirmed_api_gap: Native squid views still lack Beta SquidEntity/WaterCreatureEntity identity. Cap accounting handles native WaterAnimal directly. No broken MoC predation branch was demonstrated.
unverified_moc_branches: BigCat rope following and teleport fallback
validation: No exhaustive playthrough of every rare branch across both mods.
No live client GPU validation of carried poses, projectile/pickup visuals or GUI interactions.

limitations: Native tests use NeoForge 21.1.258; Prism uses 21.1.265 on Minecraft 1.21.1.
Controlled budget release proves scheduling and insertion with room available, not guaranteed abundance in untouched player worlds.
